failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first committed-domain manifest probe embedded unnecessary temporary-file cleanup and was rejected by host policy before any process, file, Git, or remote action.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Used a scalar no-temp Python Git-blob verifier with no filesystem mutation.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Committed-domain verification reads Git blobs directly and never creates a temporary file merely to hash them.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The pushed evidence manifest recorded checkout CRLF bytes for twenty skill-creator YAML companions, while their committed Git blobs were normalized to LF; all twenty entries failed exact hash and byte parity.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Retained the original evidence commit and manifest, then built a separate full-owner correction manifest from normalized index blobs before an additive evidence-correction commit.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Every commit-bound manifest hashes index or Git-tree blobs in the named normalized-LF domain; checkout-byte receipts remain a separate domain.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first exact correction staging command staged eight in-sparse documents but refused the new correction builder and test because those exact owner paths were outside the inherited sparse specification.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Used git add --sparse for only the two named owner paths, then restaged the rebuilt correction documents and verified the exact index allowlist.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: When an additive owner path is intentionally outside inherited sparse patterns, use --sparse with an exact path and verify the staged allowlist immediately.

failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first full correction-test wrapper ended after two progress markers with no attributable summary or exit status; no surviving test process could establish completion.
failed_witnesses.recovery: Ran the unchanged eight-test module in a resumable terminal session and waited for its explicit test count, verdict, and exit code.
failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Long manifest-parity selections use a resumable session; partial progress output never earns completion credit.
